title: Memory / Canon shell (approved-only empty states)
goal: Add a read-only Memory / Canon shell for approved-only project knowledge categories, showing safe empty states and clear candidate/canon boundaries without adding apply-promotion, approved-memory mutation, extraction, generated summaries, model calls, semantic search, or browser/manual validation.
why_now: PHASE7-IMPL-008 completed the frontend-transient OMI-guided staged creation shell. The workspace can now expose the next approved-memory/canon area as a read-only shell before any apply-promotion or durable memory mutation exists.

include: Inventory existing Memory / Canon and approved-memory specs.
Inventory current frontend/backend/test surfaces for a read-only approved-memory shell.
Define a conservative child task sequence for approved-only empty states.
Keep OMI candidates, approved-but-not-applied candidates, and promotion records out of approved canon displays.
exclude: Runtime Memory / Canon shell implementation during T001.
Apply-promotion, promotion execution, memory/canon mutation, approved-truth mutation.
Generated prose, AI-written story content, summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, Dramatica analysis, model calls, Ollama calls.
Training data, JSONL data, dataset artifacts, browser/manual validation.
Metadata editing UI, note/material create/import/upload UI, category detail editing.

quality_notes: Direct read-only inspection of roadmap authority, specs, frontend surfaces, backend surfaces, and existing test surfaces was used.
No runtime code or tests were changed.
No CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context generation, MCP tools, LeanCTX, app servers, frontend builds, model calls, or Ollama calls were run.

frontend.notes: Has Overview and editor workspace views. No Memory / Canon view exists yet.
Has Overview workspace nav plus scene/note/material document navigation. Memory / Canon can be added as a workspace view, not a document type.
Shows a simple approved-memory/canon empty-state line but is not the dedicated shell.
Candidate and promotion audit UI. Its records must not be treated as approved memory/canon.
No approved-memory helper exists; initial empty-state shell can avoid API changes.

backend.notes: No approved-memory/canon helpers, no apply-promotion helper, and no memory/canon mutation helper exist.
No Memory / Canon routes and no apply-promotion route exist.

tests.notes: Primary source-level test surface for upcoming approved-memory shell contracts.
Covers backend project/OMI safety; future backend memory work would need focused coverage if introduced.

acceptance_criteria: Approved-only empty states exist for the required categories.
OMI candidates and promotion records are not displayed as approved canon.
No apply-promotion or memory/canon mutation is added.
No generated prose, summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, model/Ollama calls, training/JSONL/dataset work, or browser/manual validation is added.

validation.notes: Docs/status only. No pytest commands are required unless runtime or tests are changed.

safety_notes: Promotion records are audit records, not applied memory.
Approved-but-not-applied candidates must not appear in approved lists.
Missing memory storage is a valid empty state.
Opening the shell must not create memory files or mutate OMI, bible, storyform, scenes, notes, materials, project metadata, training data, or datasets.
deferred_work: Approved-memory read APIs unless a later contract proves they are needed.
Extraction and candidate creation from prose.
Semantic search, graph/canon queries, and relationship visualization.
